d:
Serah Farron from the Final Fantasy XIII takes it upon herself to teach the miniflans of the Sunleth Waterscape in the Year 4XX AF (the good timeline of the Year 400 AF) what it means to coexist peacefully with humans, instead of just being little scoundrels pestering passerbys!

Will she accomplish this goal of hers, or will her rage-prone temper overwhelm her?

Super cute comic.

You could tell that Serah is Lightnning's sister, when she is serious, she looks almost exactly like her sister.

You can find my and other's AI GEN comics here as well:
